title: No thanks, unsafe for us
text: No thanks, unsafe for us. I don't doubt this mat is helpful to some but not for my husband and I.  The mat is very well made, no doubt of that, but we find it a safety issue.  All our shoes stick to this mat which moves the mat around.  My feet are very sensitive and I find this mat too hard to stand on. Very disappointed in this purchase.  What we will do is cut this mat up to set under our desk.  Do not recommend this product.

product_metadata.title: Kitchen Mats for Floor Anti Fatigue, Kitchen Rug 1/2 inch Thick, Non-Slip Extra Support Standing Pad Black
features: Anti-Fatigue Mats for Standing: Incredibly comfortable to stand on, this standing mat provides cushioned comfort and a decorative appeal. Making your cooking or washing experience both enjoyable and comfortable.
Narrow Side Design: Differs from the beveled edges on the market, this mat is designed of narrow side which provide more flat surface area for standing.

Non-Slipping Backing: The non-skid backing helps to keep the mat securely in place & prevents slipping, sliding or tripping. Perfect for any high traffic areas in your home such as kitchen, office, garage , or laundry room.
PVC Eco-friendly: 100% PVC construction. Phathalate-free, latex-free, and smell-free. Even if there are babies or pets in your house, the mat is very safe for your families.
Waterproof & Oil Proof: Consideing how much we cook and walk in the kitchen, the material of the mat become important. Low rebound foamed PVC material, anti-oil, waterproof, easier to clean.
